005package org.wpilib.hardware.hal;
006
007/**
008 * Encoder JNI Functions.
009 *
010 * @see "wpi/hal/Encoder.h"
011 */
012public class EncoderJNI extends JNIWrapper {
013  /**
014   * Initializes an encoder.
015   *
016   * @param aChannel the A channel
017   * @param bChannel the B channel
018   * @param reverseDirection true to reverse the counting direction from standard, otherwise false
019   * @param encodingType the encoding type
020   * @return the created encoder handle
021   * @see "HAL_InitializeEncoder"
022   */
023  public static native int initializeEncoder(
024      int aChannel, int bChannel, boolean reverseDirection, int encodingType);
025
026  /**
027   * Frees an encoder.
028   *
029   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
030   * @see "HAL_FreeEncoder"
031   */
032  public static native void freeEncoder(int encoderHandle);
033
034  /**
035   * Indicates the encoder is used by a simulated device.
036   *
037   * @param handle the encoder handle
038   * @param device simulated device handle
039   * @see "HAL_SetEncoderSimDevice"
040   */
041  public static native void setEncoderSimDevice(int handle, int device);
042
043  /**
044   * Gets the current counts of the encoder after encoding type scaling.
045   *
046   * <p>This is scaled by the value passed during initialization to encodingType.
047   *
048   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
049   * @return the current scaled count
050   * @see "HAL_GetEncoder"
051   */
052  public static native int getEncoder(int encoderHandle);
053
054  /**
055   * Gets the raw counts of the encoder.
056   *
057   * <p>This is not scaled by any values.
058   *
059   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
060   * @return the raw encoder count
061   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderRaw"
062   */
063  public static native int getEncoderRaw(int encoderHandle);
064
065  /**
066   * Gets the scale value used to convert raw encoder counts to scaled counts.
067   *
068   * <p>Raw counts divided by this value produce the scaled encoder count.
069   *
070   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
071   * @return the encoder scale value
072   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderEncodingScale"
073   */
074  public static native int getEncodingScaleFactor(int encoderHandle);
075
076  /**
077   * Reads the current encoder value.
078   *
079   * <p>Read the value at this instant. It may still be running, so it reflects the current value.
080   * Next time it is read, it might have a different value.
081   *
082   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
083   * @see "HAL_ResetEncoder"
084   */
085  public static native void resetEncoder(int encoderHandle);
086
087  /**
088   * Determines if the clock is stopped.
089   *
090   * <p>Determines if the encoder's current rate is zero.
091   *
092   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
093   * @return true if the encoder's current rate is zero
094   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderStopped"
095   */
096  public static native boolean getEncoderStopped(int encoderHandle);
097
098  /**
099   * Gets the last direction the encoder value changed.
100   *
101   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
102   * @return the last direction the encoder value changed
103   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderDirection"
104   */
105  public static native boolean getEncoderDirection(int encoderHandle);
106
107  /**
108   * Gets the current distance traveled by the encoder.
109   *
110   * <p>This is the encoder count scaled by the distance per pulse set for the encoder.
111   *
112   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
113   * @return the encoder distance (units are determined by the units passed to
114   *     setEncoderDistancePerPulse)
115   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderDistance"
116   */
117  public static native double getEncoderDistance(int encoderHandle);
118
119  /**
120   * Gets the current rate of the encoder.
121   *
122   * <p>This is the encoder rate scaled by the distance per pulse set for the encoder.
123   *
124   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
125   * @return the encoder rate (units are determined by the units passed to
126   *     setEncoderDistancePerPulse, time value is seconds)
127   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderRate"
128   */
129  public static native double getEncoderRate(int encoderHandle);
130
131  /**
132   * Sets the time window used to calculate the encoder rate.
133   *
134   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
135   * @param windowMilliseconds the rate calculation window in milliseconds; valid values are 5
136   *     through 255
137   * @see "HAL_SetEncoderRateWindow"
138   */
139  public static native void setEncoderRateWindow(int encoderHandle, int windowMilliseconds);
140
141  /**
142   * Sets the distance traveled per encoder pulse. This is used as a scaling factor for the rate and
143   * distance calls.
144   *
145   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
146   * @param distancePerPulse the distance traveled per encoder pulse (units user defined)
147   * @see "HAL_SetEncoderDistancePerPulse"
148   */
149  public static native void setEncoderDistancePerPulse(int encoderHandle, double distancePerPulse);
150
151  /**
152   * Sets if to reverse the direction of the encoder.
153   *
154   * <p>Note that this is not a toggle. It is an absolute set.
155   *
156   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
157   * @param reverseDirection true to reverse the direction, false to not.
158   * @see "HAL_SetEncoderReverseDirection"
159   */
160  public static native void setEncoderReverseDirection(int encoderHandle, boolean reverseDirection);
161
162  /**
163   * Gets the FPGA index of the encoder.
164   *
165   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
166   * @return the FPGA index of the encoder
167   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderFPGAIndex"
168   */
169  public static native int getEncoderFPGAIndex(int encoderHandle);
170
171  /**
172   * Gets the scale value used to convert raw encoder counts to scaled counts.
173   *
174   * <p>Raw counts divided by this value produce the scaled encoder count.
175   *
176   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
177   * @return the encoder scale value
178   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderEncodingScale"
179   */
180  public static native int getEncoderEncodingScale(int encoderHandle);
181
182  /**
183   * Gets the decoding scale factor of the encoder.
184   *
185   * <p>This is used to perform the scaling from raw to type scaled values.
186   *
187   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
188   * @return the scale value for the encoder
189   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderDecodingScaleFactor"
190   */
191  public static native double getEncoderDecodingScaleFactor(int encoderHandle);
192
193  /**
194   * Gets the user set distance per pulse of the encoder.
195   *
196   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
197   * @return the set distance per pulse
198   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderDistancePerPulse"
199   */
200  public static native double getEncoderDistancePerPulse(int encoderHandle);
201
202  /**
203   * Gets the encoding type of the encoder.
204   *
205   * @param encoderHandle the encoder handle
206   * @return the encoding type
207   * @see "HAL_GetEncoderEncodingType"
208   */
209  public static native int getEncoderEncodingType(int encoderHandle);
210
211  /** Utility class. */
212  private EncoderJNI() {}
213}
